items.title: Hafnia Q3 profit $170.8m; Q4 74% covered at $55,148/day
items.summary: Hafnia's Q3 net profit rose to $170.8m ($0.34/share) from $91.5m a year earlier. Q3 TCE per operating day: LR2 $38,919, LR1 $43,052, MR $30,220, Handy $25,713 (fleet $32,708). As of Nov 13, 74% of Q4 earning days were fixed at $55,148/day; the company notes LR2s are being drawn into dirty trades.

items.title: Hafnia drops TORM merger, plans to exit 19.85% stake
items.summary: Hafnia will unwind its 20.36m TORM shares (about $686.6m at the Nov 17 close of $33.73), preferably as a dividend in kind of 1 TORM share per 26.3 Hafnia shares, replacing regular Q3/Q4 cash dividends. If the needed third-party cooperation is not in place by Nov 25, it will instead pay a cash dividend of 90% of Q3 profit.

items.title: Hanwha Philly starts first Jones Act MR chemical/product tanker
items.summary: Steel was cut on Nov 17 for the first of four 49,500 dwt MRs for Hanwha Shipping, built to IMO Type 2/3 chemical standards (optional 18-segregation layout) for Jones Act crude, product and chemical trades. Deliveries are planned for 2029–2030.

items.title: CIMC SOE takes first MR order: 10 × 49,900 dwt
items.summary: Stamford Shipping ordered ten conventionally fuelled MRs for 2029–2030 delivery, and a European owner added two more of the same design. About 190 MR2s were on order in late October; BRS puts the MR2 orderbook at roughly 16% of the fleet, with average age 12.5 years.

items.title: EU sanctions list adds 113 shadow-fleet names
items.summary: The EU package announced Nov 16 lists 12 individuals and 101 entities based in the UAE, Oman, Seychelles and China, including Dubai traders Lidoil DMCC and Spikoil DMCC, several ship managers, Moscow insurer Balance Insurance and JSC Petersburg Oil Terminal. Nearly 50 Russian banks were also added.

items.title: VLCC Gulf of Oman–China rate down 64% from October record
items.summary: Baltic Exchange data put the route at about WS308 on Nov 13, against a record WS841 on Oct 8, as Gulf exports recovered to near pre-war volumes via STS transfers and dark transits. Analysts at Arrow and Vortexa point to Asian buyers returning to Gulf crude and growing vessel availability.

items.title: Fewer empty tankers heading into the Gulf, tracker says
items.summary: Tankertrackers.com estimates combined VLCC and Suezmax ballast capacity sailing to the Gulf is down about 40% since end-August, with some owners refusing Hormuz and loading in the Gulf of Oman from shuttle ships. Regional flows have dipped in November, but the tracker says the cause and scale are not yet clear.

items.title: LPG tanker Tara Gas struck twice near Khasab; one crew missing
items.summary: UKMTO reported an attack about 7 nm north of Khasab at 1900 UTC on Nov 16 that disabled the Panama-flagged ship and started an engine-room fire, followed by a second strike. India says 24 of 25 crew are accounted for, two hospitalized and one missing; a separate outbound tanker was also hit on Nov 16 with no casualties. Responsibility has not been independently established.

items.title: Coast Guard sets New Orleans safety zone through Dec 11
items.summary: A temporary zone covers Lower Mississippi miles 95.5–96.5, 500 ft off the east bank near the Crescent City Connection, for salvage of the capsized riverboat American Heritage after the Nov 13 allision by tanker Atlantic Asphalt. The river is not closed: limited two-way traffic uses the main span, with deep-draft ships and tows of 10+ barges one-way. NTSB preliminary data cite a steering casualty; cause undetermined.

items.title: Houston Ship Channel pilot indicted over 2024 collision
items.summary: A federal grand jury on Nov 10 charged the pilot of the bulker Yangze 7 with misconduct or neglect over the July 19, 2024 collision that sank the tug Miss Peggy near Lynchburg and killed a crew member. The NTSB had found a 39-minute personal phone call ending about two minutes before impact; first court appearance is Nov 25.

items.title: LA/Long Beach security workers could strike from Nov 21
items.summary: About 250 ILWU Local 26 members, who staff six terminals handling roughly 85% of Long Beach and 33% of LA cargo per PMA, may walk out at 12:01 a.m. Saturday when their extension expires. Talks resume Friday; the coastwide dockworker contract runs to 2028.

items.title: DHL: Suez return will not quickly clear container congestion
items.summary: DHL estimates about 3.6m TEU, over 10% of the container fleet, is tied up in port congestion, with some Gulf gateways seeing berth delays above two weeks. About 60% of Asia–Europe headhaul services plan to use Suez, and the transition may take 6–12 months if security holds.

items.title: Kerch Bridge span reportedly blocks Azov–Black Sea channel
items.summary: Ukrainian officials say strikes on Nov 15–17 dropped a road span into the main navigable channel of the Kerch Strait, which would halt large-vessel traffic between the Sea of Azov and the Black Sea. The damage claims have not been independently confirmed; Russia says the bridge will be rebuilt.

items.title: Panama Canal raises Neopanamax draft to 50 ft
items.summary: An ACP advisory raises daily slots from 33 to 34 (24 Panamax, 10 Neopanamax) and lifts maximum Neopanamax draft to 15.24 m (50 ft) from 49 ft in October, as water levels improve.

items.title: Iran strikes at Bahrain again; US hits missile site on Qeshm
items.summary: Iran launched drones at a US radar site in Bahrain on Nov 17, its third attack in five days; Bahrain says they were intercepted and the US reports no damage. A US official said a US jet then struck a Revolutionary Guard launch site on Qeshm Island (not independently confirmed). Qatar warned the escalation endangers mediation.

items.title: Ukraine says it cut Kerch Bridge; Russia reports 1,441 drones downed
items.summary: Ukraine's military says a road span of the Crimea bridge collapsed; AP could not verify this. Russia reported shooting down 1,441 Ukrainian drones, about 800 aimed at the Moscow region, while Russian missiles hit two Kyiv bridges, killing at least two. The UK pledged £240m for Ukrainian air defense.

items.title: Trump arrives in Shenzhen; Trump–Xi–Putin meeting set for Thursday
items.summary: Xi met Trump on arrival for APEC, and the first three-way meeting with Putin is scheduled for Nov 19. Trump says he will raise Ukraine and nuclear arms limits; analysts expect no breakthroughs. Earlier, he announced a trade deal with the Philippines, with few details released.

items.title: Dow drops 849 points; Fed's Musalem calls for rate hikes
items.summary: The Dow closed at 50,759.42 (−1.64%) on Nov 17, with the S&P 500 down about 1%. St. Louis Fed President Musalem said 100–150 bp of hikes may be needed by spring 2027. October retail sales rose 0.2%; Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $115.8bn, up 103% y/y.

items.title: COP31 draft text divides negotiators
items.summary: Australia's 18-page draft calls for a fossil-fuel phaseout and net zero for wealthy nations by 2030; the EU's Wopke Hoekstra said it could make talks untenable. Talks in Antalya are scheduled to end Nov 20, and another draft is expected before then.

items.title: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire at risk
items.summary: In a report to the UN Security Council, the US-backed board said the truce in place since Oct 10, 2025 could collapse without immediate implementation, citing shortfalls by both Israel and Hamas, aid restrictions and funding gaps ahead of winter.

items.title: Texans (3–6) host Colts Thursday, 7:15 PM CT
items.summary: Houston lost 27–24 at Cleveland on Nov 15 after leading 17–0 and is 2nd in the AFC South (Jaguars 7–2, Colts 3–7, Titans 1–8). Colts at Texans is Thu Nov 19, 7:15 PM CT on Prime Video; Houston is a 9.5-point favorite. Official game statuses had not been released at last check.

items.title: Broncos (7–2) host Raiders Sunday, 3:25 PM CT
items.summary: Coming off a Week 10 bye after a 26–21 win at Carolina on Nov 8 (five straight wins), Denver is tied with Kansas City at 7–2 atop the AFC West and won the only meeting 28–24 on Nov 1. Raiders (4–6) at Broncos is Sun Nov 22, 3:25 PM CT on CBS.

items.title: ATP Finals: Alcaraz beats Medvedev, nears semifinals
items.summary: Alcaraz won 6–2, 6–4 in 72 minutes on Nov 18 to go 2–0 in the Lendl Group; he had treatment on his upper left leg in the second set. He qualifies if Tiafoe takes a set from Cobolli tonight, and plays Cobolli on Friday. Medvedev is 1–1.

items.title: ATP Finals: Zverev into semifinals; Fils beats Jodar
items.summary: On Nov 17 Zverev beat Shelton 6–2, 7–6(4) to go 2–0 and qualify from the McEnroe Group; Fils, now a career-high No. 7, beat Jodar 4–6, 6–2, 6–2 and plays Zverev Thursday. Fils and Shelton are 1–1, Jodar 0–2.

items.title: Andreeva wins WTA Finals unbeaten; rises to No. 2
items.summary: Mirra Andreeva beat Elina Svitolina 7–5, 6–3 in the Nov 15 final, winning all five matches without dropping a set, and moves to world No. 2. Siniakova/Townsend won the doubles title over Errani/Paolini.
